HTML comments are stripped before matching — these builds quote the constraint verbatim in prose comments, so an unstripped comment saying ILLUSTRATIVE would satisfy the check it was explaining, the same shape as the Lottie guard that fired on the comment describing the trap it prevented. --selftest covers both poisonings.
